headline: ROUND 122 — CANONICAL RECONSTRUCTION

events.title: THE CAMPAIGN ARCHIVE CONSOLIDATES DUPLICATED INTELLIGENCE REPORTS
events.body: The campaign and commercial archives discover overlapping report series and retire duplicated entries from the authoritative intelligence ledger while preserving the underlying sources. The development is recorded within the existing campaign institutions and established relationships rather than as an unrelated occurrence. The people and organizations already attached to the thread continue their work under the arrangements established in earlier rounds. No unsupported office, ownership claim, future revenue, or additional manpower is created by the report. The associated records are preserved so the matter can continue to develop in later rounds. The result is therefore a concrete continuation of the established simulation rather than a forced historical outcome.

classification_audit.causal_basis: Material development of an established campaign thread.
